Wei.name: Cao Fang
Wei.title: Prince of Qi
Wei.note: From 249 the Sima family held real power.

Wei.name: Cao Huan
Wei.title: Emperor Yuan
Wei.note: Gave the throne to Sima Yan in 266.

Shu Han.name: Liu Shan
Shu Han.title: Later Lord
Shu Han.note: Zhuge Liang ran the state as chancellor until 234.

Wu.name: Sun Quan
Wu.title: Emperor Da
Wu.note: King of Wu from 222, emperor from 229.

yiling.note: Lu Xun waited months, then burned Liu Bei's long line of camps.
yiling.note_zh: 陆逊坚守数月后火烧刘备连营。

wuzhang.note: Sima Yi refused battle; after Zhuge Liang died the Shu army withdrew.
wuzhang.note_zh: 司马懿坚守不战，诸葛亮病逝后蜀军撤退。

liaodong-campaign.note: After the city fell Sima Yi had thousands of men killed.
liaodong-campaign.note_zh: 城破后司马懿屠杀数千人。

wei-shu.note: Jiang Wei held Jiange against Zhong Hui, but Deng Ai went around by the Yinping road.
wei-shu.note_zh: 姜维在剑阁挡住钟会，邓艾却偷渡阴平直取成都。

routes.name: Liu Bei's campaign against Wu
routes.summary: Liu Bei marched down the Yangtze gorges to avenge Guan Yu and was routed at Yiling.
routes.summary_zh: 刘备沿长江三峡东下为关羽报仇，在夷陵大败。

routes.name: Zhuge Liang's southern campaign
routes.summary: Zhuge Liang crossed the Lu River into Yunnan to win over the southern chiefs.
routes.summary_zh: 诸葛亮渡泸水深入南中，平定叛乱、收服豪帅。

routes.name: Zhuge Liang's first northern campaign
routes.summary: Shu advanced via Qishan, but the defeat at Jieting forced a retreat.
routes.summary_zh: 蜀军出祁山北伐，因街亭失守而退回。

routes.name: Zhuge Liang's last northern campaign
routes.summary: Zhuge Liang went through the Xie valley to Wuzhang Plain, where he died in camp.
routes.summary_zh: 诸葛亮出斜谷进驻五丈原，病逝军中。

routes.name: Sima Yi's Liaodong campaign
routes.summary: Sima Yi marched from Luoyang to the northeast and took Xiangping.
routes.summary_zh: 司马懿从洛阳远征东北，攻克襄平。

routes.name: Guanqiu Jian's campaign against Goguryeo
routes.summary: Wei troops sacked Hwando and chased the Goguryeo king to the northeast; the pursuit route is approximate.
routes.summary_zh: 魏军攻破丸都，追击高句丽王至东北沃沮一带，追击路线为大致示意。

routes.name: Deng Ai's march by the Yinping road
routes.summary: Deng Ai crossed wild mountains by the Yinping road and reached Chengdu, ending Shu Han.
routes.summary_zh: 邓艾经阴平小道翻越险山直抵成都，蜀汉灭亡。

people.name: Zhong Yao
people.known_for: Wei statesman and calligrapher regarded as a founder of regular script (kaishu).
people.known_for_zh: 曹魏重臣、书法家，被视为楷书的奠基人。

people.name: Cao Zhi
people.known_for: The leading poet of the Jian'an age, son of Cao Cao.
people.known_for_zh: 曹操之子，建安文学最杰出的诗人。

works.title: Rhapsody on the Luo River Goddess

people.line_en: Light as a startled swan, graceful as a swimming dragon.

people.name: He Yan
people.known_for: With Wang Bi, founded Xuanxue ('Dark Learning'), blending Daoism with Confucian texts.
people.known_for_zh: 与王弼共同开创玄学，以道家思想解释儒家经典。

people.name: Wang Bi
people.known_for: Young philosopher whose commentaries on the Laozi and Book of Changes shaped Chinese thought for centuries.
people.known_for_zh: 青年哲学家，其《老子》《周易》注影响后世数百年。

works.title: Commentary on the Book of Changes

people.name: Zhu Shixing
people.known_for: The first Chinese monk known to travel west for scriptures, reaching Khotan in 260.
people.known_for_zh: 已知最早西行求法的汉地僧人，260年抵达于阗。

people.name: Ruan Ji
people.known_for: Poet and leader of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人，竹林七贤的代表人物。
people.line_zh: 夜中不能寐，起坐弹鸣琴。
people.line_en: Unable to sleep at midnight, I rise and sit to play my zither.

people.name: Ji Kang
people.known_for: Musician, poet and free-thinking member of the Seven Sages, executed by the Sima regime.
people.known_for_zh: 竹林七贤之一，音乐家、诗人和思想家，遭司马氏杀害。

works.title: Letter Breaking Off Relations with Shan Tao

people.name: Liu Bei
people.known_for: Han royal relative who founded the Shu Han state in Sichuan with Zhuge Liang's help.
people.known_for_zh: 汉室宗亲，得诸葛亮辅佐，建立蜀汉。

people.name: Sun Quan
people.known_for: Founding emperor of Eastern Wu who allied with Liu Bei to defeat Cao Cao at Red Cliffs.
people.known_for_zh: 东吴开国皇帝，联刘抗曹，赤壁大胜。

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.known_for: Chancellor of Shu Han and legendary strategist, epitome of wisdom and loyalty.
people.known_for_zh: 蜀汉丞相，智慧与忠诚的化身。

people.name: Zhang Fei
people.known_for: Fierce sworn brother of Liu Bei, famed for holding Changban Bridge.
people.known_for_zh: 刘备结义兄弟，当阳长坂桥喝退曹军。

people.name: Zhao Yun
people.known_for: Shu general famed for rescuing Liu Bei's infant son at Changban.
people.known_for_zh: 蜀汉名将，长坂坡单骑救主。

people.name: Lu Xun
people.known_for: Wu general who routed Liu Bei at Yiling in 222 and later became chancellor.
people.known_for_zh: 夷陵之战火烧连营大败刘备，后任东吴丞相。

people.name: Sima Yi
people.known_for: Wei general and regent who resisted Zhuge Liang and seized power in 249, paving the way for Jin.
people.known_for_zh: 曹魏重臣，抵御诸葛亮北伐，高平陵之变夺权。

people.name: Cao Pi
people.known_for: Son of Cao Cao who ended the Han in 220 as first Wei emperor and wrote early literary criticism.
people.known_for_zh: 受汉禅建立曹魏，著《典论·论文》。

people.name: Jia Xu
people.known_for: Shrewd strategist who served several warlords before advising Cao Cao and Cao Pi.
people.known_for_zh: 善于自保的谋士，先后事多主，终为曹魏太尉。

people.name: Jiang Wei
people.known_for: Zhuge Liang's successor who led Shu's northern campaigns until the state fell.
people.known_for_zh: 继承诸葛亮遗志，九伐中原。

people.name: Deng Ai
people.known_for: Wei general who crossed the mountains at Yinping and forced Shu Han's surrender in 263.
people.known_for_zh: 偷渡阴平，迫降蜀汉。

people.name: Zhong Hui
people.known_for: Wei general who led the conquest of Shu, then rebelled and was killed in Chengdu.
people.known_for_zh: 率军伐蜀，后在成都谋反被杀。

people.name: Zhang Liao
people.known_for: Wei general who routed Sun Quan's huge army at Xiaoyao Ford with 800 men.
people.known_for_zh: 以八百人在逍遥津大破孙权。

people.name: Ma Chao
people.known_for: Liang Province warlord who fought Cao Cao at Tong Pass before joining Liu Bei.
people.known_for_zh: 西凉猛将，潼关大战曹操，后归刘备。

people.name: Zhang Zhao
people.known_for: Senior Wu minister and guardian of Sun Quan, leader of the faction urging peace with Cao Cao.
people.known_for_zh: 东吴元老重臣，受孙策托孤辅佐孙权。

people.name: Zhuge Ke
people.known_for: Wu regent who won at Dongxing but was killed after a failed campaign against Wei.
people.known_for_zh: 东吴权臣，东兴大捷，后伐魏失败被杀。

people.name: Liu Shan
people.known_for: Last emperor of Shu Han who reigned 40 years and surrendered to Wei in 263.
people.known_for_zh: 蜀汉后主，在位四十年，263年降魏。

people.name: Lady Zhen
people.known_for: Wife of Cao Pi and mother of Emperor Ming of Wei, celebrated as a great beauty.
people.known_for_zh: 曹丕之妻，魏明帝之母，以美貌著称。

people.name: Ma Jun
people.known_for: Wei engineer who built a south-pointing chariot, improved looms and a chain pump.
people.known_for_zh: 机械发明家，造指南车，改进织绫机和翻车。

people.name: Liu Hui
people.known_for: Mathematician whose 263 commentary on the Nine Chapters computed pi by polygon approximation.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，263年注《九章算术》，用割圆术计算圆周率。

people.name: Kang Senghui
people.known_for: Sogdian monk born in Jiaozhi who brought Buddhism to Wu and founded Jianchu Temple.
people.known_for_zh: 祖籍康居的僧人，于建业创建建初寺，佛教传入江南。

people.name: Dong Feng
people.known_for: Physician on Mount Lu who asked patients to plant apricot trees as fees, origin of 'apricot grove' for medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 庐山名医，病愈者植杏为酬，“杏林”典故出处。

people.name: Wang Fan
people.known_for: Wu astronomer who built a celestial globe and refined the measurement of the heavens.
people.known_for_zh: 东吴天文学家，制作浑象，著《浑天象说》。

people.name: Yu Fan
people.known_for: Wu Yijing scholar exiled to the far south, where he taught hundreds of students.
people.known_for_zh: 易学家，被流放交州，讲学不倦。

people.name: Xiang Xiu
people.known_for: Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove member whose Zhuangzi commentary shaped Xuanxue.
people.known_for_zh: 竹林七贤之一，注《庄子》，作《思旧赋》。

people.name: Sima Zhao
people.known_for: Wei regent who conquered Shu; 'Sima Zhao's heart is known to all' became a byword for ambition.
people.known_for_zh: 曹魏权臣，灭蜀，“司马昭之心，路人皆知”。

people.name: Jiang Wan
people.known_for: Zhuge Liang's successor as head of the Shu Han government.
people.known_for_zh: 继诸葛亮主持蜀汉朝政。

people.name: Wang Su
people.known_for: Wei classicist who challenged Zheng Xuan and is linked to the Family Sayings of Confucius.
people.known_for_zh: 曹魏经学家，与郑学相抗，注《孔子家语》。

people.name: Zhuge Jin
people.known_for: Elder brother of Zhuge Liang who served Wu as a trusted general and diplomat.
people.known_for_zh: 诸葛亮之兄，东吴大将军，多次出使蜀汉。

people.name: Huangfu Mi
people.known_for: Compiled the oldest surviving systematic book on acupuncture.
people.known_for_zh: 编成现存最早的系统针灸学著作。

works.title: Systematic Classic of Acupuncture and Moxibustion

people.name: Chen Shou
people.known_for: Wrote the official history of the Three Kingdoms.
people.known_for_zh: 撰写三国时期的正史。

people.name: Sima Yan (Emperor Wu of Jin)
people.known_for: Founder of the Jin dynasty who reunified China by conquering Wu in 280.
people.known_for_zh: 建立西晋，280年灭吴统一全国。

people.name: Pei Xiu
people.known_for: Cartographer who set out six principles of map-making, including grid scale.
people.known_for_zh: 地图学家，提出“制图六体”。

works.title: Maps of the Regions of the Yu Gong

people.name: Yang Hu
people.known_for: Jin commander at Xiangyang who prepared the conquest of Wu through benevolent frontier rule.
people.known_for_zh: 镇守襄阳，以德怀柔，筹划灭吴。

people.name: Du Yu
people.known_for: General who led the conquest of Wu and scholar of the Zuo Commentary.
people.known_for_zh: 率军灭吴的统帅，著《春秋左氏经传集解》。

works.title: Collected Explanations of the Zuo Zhuan

people.name: Wang Jun
people.known_for: Admiral who built a great fleet in Sichuan and sailed down the Yangtze to take Jianye in 280.
people.known_for_zh: 在蜀造楼船，顺江而下攻破建业。

people.name: Shan Tao
people.known_for: Eldest of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove, later Jin minister of personnel.
people.known_for_zh: 竹林七贤之一，后任西晋吏部尚书。

people.name: Wang Rong
people.known_for: Youngest of the Seven Sages, later a high Jin minister famed for his miserliness.
people.known_for_zh: 竹林七贤中最年少者，西晋高官。

people.name: Liu Ling
people.known_for: Seven Sages member legendary for drinking, author of the Hymn to the Virtue of Wine.
people.known_for_zh: 竹林七贤之一，嗜酒，作《酒德颂》。

works.title: Hymn to the Virtue of Wine

people.name: Zhang Hua
people.known_for: Jin statesman and author of the Treatise on Curiosities, an encyclopaedia of marvels.
people.known_for_zh: 西晋重臣，著《博物志》。

people.name: Wang Shuhe
people.known_for: Physician who compiled the Pulse Classic and re-edited Zhang Zhongjing's treatise.
people.known_for_zh: 医学家，著《脉经》，整理《伤寒论》。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia gives Wang Shuhe as c. 210?–258?, not 180–270.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称王叔和约生于210年、卒于258年，而非180–270年。

people.name: Fotudeng
people.known_for: Central Asian monk who won Later Zhao rulers' patronage and spread Buddhism across the north.
people.known_for_zh: 西域高僧，受后赵崇信，在北方大弘佛法。

capitals.name: Luoyang
capitals.note: Cao Pi rebuilt Luoyang after ending the Han in 220.
capitals.note_zh: 220年曹丕代汉后重建洛阳并定都。

capitals.name: Wuchang
capitals.note: Sun Hao moved back here briefly in 265–266.

capitals.name: Jianye
capitals.note: Wu's capital until Jin conquered it in 280.
capitals.note_zh: 东吴都城，直到280年为晋所灭。
